l5_ecog3_meaning.quote: Intensive salvage chemotherapy, a second CAR-T, allogeneic transplant and most clinical trials are not realistic options at ECOG 3 because of high treatment-related morbidity and mortality, poor tolerance, and low likelihood of durable benefit

l5_capacity.quote: confirm his understanding and his goals (home, family, comfort)

l5_respect_refusal_goc.quote: I would respect his decision, document it clearly, and proceed with a comfort-focused plan rather than trying to persuade him to continue anticancer therapy.

l5_advance_directive.quote: complete advance care planning including a health care proxy, code status/DNR-DNI and a POLST if appropriate

l5_financial_social_work.quote: I would involve social work and a financial navigator immediately, screen openly for out-of-pocket costs, insurance gaps and debt, and connect the family to concrete resources.

l5_caregiver_support.quote: I would connect the wife to respite care, caregiver support and counseling for exhaustion, and the daughter to FMLA/employer caregiver resources

l5_mn_pressure_treatment.quote: I would respect his decision, document it clearly, and proceed with a comfort-focused plan rather than trying to persuade him to continue anticancer therapy.

l5_mn_abandon.quote: it is active comfort care, not abandonment
